question: Does the fixed universal-HMT matter coupling plus equivalence/GR/PPN recovery impose an exact action-level relation that uniquely selects the scalar-response-relevant matter interface, or only phenomenological constraints with a continuous allowed parameter region?

independent_sources.role: universal HMT coupling and projectable/nonprojectable PPN analysis

decision_rule: EXACT_SELECTOR requires the audited action/PPN source to derive a unique equality fixing every scalar-response-relevant universal-HMT matter-interface parameter independently of RTK response. CONTINUOUS_REGION applies when the source instead states that all solar-system tests are satisfied in a large parameter region and GR PPN values can be realized by choosing constants, leaving a continuous family. INCOMPLETE applies if those source statements cannot be locked.
required_guards: do not convert observational inequalities into equalities
do not choose a representative point from the allowed PPN region
do not claim C9 naturalness closure
